added.title: leolegends/carbon-superagent
added.reason: Created 20:51Z, first commit 20:45Z, package 0.2.0 at 21:08Z. Local panel inspired by the prototype attention principle. Executors are a logged-in claude or codex CLI (default claude), not DSH. Claude is disallowed git commit, git push, git reset --hard, and rm -rf; the panel commits. Each task gets a worktree branch agent/<slug>-<id6> under the data dir. acceptMode defaults to observe and autoPush defaults to false; when push is on, observe opens a draft PR. Node >=22.13. MIT. Author says it is not affiliated with DeepSeek, Anthropic, or OpenAI.

updated.title: Meaple-SFKY/Super-Agent-Plugin
updated.change: HEAD 606f51a4e5 at 21:11Z. Settings (repo, stateDir, github wrapper/login/operators) are read from the sa-super-agent row, then env, then defaults. Default state dir remains $DSH_HOME/super-agent, so profiles that share a home still share it. Default repo is Meaple-SFKY/Super-Agent-demo. Default operator login Meaple-SFKY may request work and must not act as the agent. An admitted GitHub event dispatches a Worker with no extra click. Checkout prefers git worktree add -B agent/<ticket> from repoClone (no network, base worktree untouched) and otherwise clones --depth 50. A worker-bin/gh shim and a private GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL are mounted; without a wrapper the task says it cannot push. The commit message records issue comment -> ticket -> worktree -> commit -> push -> bot PR #5 -> comment, and duplicate callbacks dispatch once. danger-full-access / approval never, skeleton description, private, and no LICENSE stay.
